WITH per_event AS (
    SELECT link_to_event,
           AVG(amount) AS avg_amount
    FROM budget
    WHERE link_to_event IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY link_to_event
),
above_overall AS (
    SELECT link_to_event,
           avg_amount,
           AVG(avg_amount) OVER () AS overall_avg
    FROM per_event
    WHERE avg_amount > (SELECT AVG(avg_amount) FROM per_event)
)
SELECT link_to_event,
       avg_amount,
       avg_amount - overall_avg AS above_overall_avg,
       avg_amount - AVG(avg_amount) OVER () AS above_kept_events_avg
FROM above_overall
ORDER BY above_kept_events_avg DESC
LIMIT 10;
